description: This file provides utility functions for exporting DOM nodes as PNG images or PDFs. It depends on 'html-to-image' for rendering DOM nodes to images and 'jspdf' for PDF generation. Functions include triggering downloads via data URLs, converting nodes to PNG and optionally downloading, and converting nodes directly into PDFs with proper sizing and rendering.

methods.name: downloadDataUrl(dataUrl, filename)
methods.description: Triggers a browser download for a given data URL and filename.

methods.name: exportNodeToPng(node, { filename, pixelRatio = 2 } = {})
methods.description: Converts a DOM node into a PNG data URL and optionally triggers a download.

methods.name: exportNodeToPdf( node, { filename = 'certificate.pdf', orientation = 'landscape', pageSize = 'a4', pixelRatio = 2 } = {} )
methods.description: Creates a PDF document from a DOM node by rendering it as a PNG and embedding into a single-page PDF.
